project: The Arabic Tongue · Layer 1 · The imitation / onomatopoeia floor
method: Each form and gloss is attested in Lisan al-Arab and/or Taj al-Arus. The charge-by-charge reading is interpretive: it identifies which letters of the word audibly reproduce the sound or gesture of the referent, using only the fixed 28-letter charges in 03-scholar-extracts/consensus-letter-charges.md. Grade PERFECT/STRONG/PARTIAL by how audibly the charges reproduce the referent. Cross-language echoes are labelled CONVERGENT (parallel imitation of the same sound), not genetic.
note: The audible proof of the charge thesis: in these words the mouth does what the referent does, so the letter-charges trace the actual sound, they are not decorative. Beside each sits a foreign word that imitates the same noise; in this project's reading that shared imitation is the common floor all tongues kept from the one origin, the layer where the sound-meaning bond began.

entries.gloss: the gurgling, trickling sound of running water (also of wind and of a sleeper)
entries.charge_reading: خ (تخلخل + اختراق) + ر (تكرار + جريان) + ي (امتداد + سريان) + ر (تكرار + جريان): a rarefied back-of-throat friction opening onto a repeated running flow, the throat rarefies and the two ر's roll the water forward. The double ر is the trickle itself.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'gurgle', French 'gargouiller', CONVERGENT: a rolled/guttural liquid imitated independently.

entries.gloss: the rustling, soft whirring sound of leaves, wings, or a garment brushing
entries.charge_reading: ح (حياة حارّة + احتواء) + ف (تفريق + نفاذ) + ي (امتداد + لين) + ف (تفريق + نفاذ): warm breath enclosed, then breath escaping between lip and teeth twice, the two ف's are the two brushing passes of the rustle, pure breath parting.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'rustle', 'whiff', CONVERGENT: breathy fricatives imitating the same soft brush.

entries.gloss: a creak, a shrill grating (of a door, a pen, teeth, a cricket)
entries.charge_reading: ص (صلابة + إطباق) + ر (تكرار + جريان) + ي (امتداد + سريان) + ر (تكرار + جريان): a hard sealed sibilant then a repeated running, the ص is the tight grating edge, the two ر's the repeated scrape drawn out.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'screech', 'scrape', CONVERGENT: a hard sibilant plus rhotic on the same grating sound.

entries.gloss: a buzzing, hissing, sizzling sound (of boiling, of a fire, of a swarm, of the chest in weeping)
entries.charge_reading: ء (تأكيد + قطع) + ز (اندفاع + اهتزاز) + ي (امتداد + سريان) + ز (اندفاع + اهتزاز): a sharp onset then two voiced vibrating thrusts drawn along an extension, the two ز's ARE the buzz, sharp voiced vibration sustained.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'buzz', 'sizzle', German 'sausen', CONVERGENT: voiced sibilant vibration imitated in parallel.

entries.gloss: a ringing, humming, droning (of the ear, a bell, an insect, a taut string)
entries.charge_reading: ط (انبساط + انتشار ثقيل) + ن (رنين + انبعاث) + ي (امتداد + لين) + ن (رنين + انبعاث): a heavy spreading strike then nasal resonance emitted, twice, ن is literally 'رنين' (ringing), and the two ن's sustain the hum.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'ring', 'ting', 'ding', CONVERGENT: nasal/velar resonance for the same sustained tone.

entries.gloss: a whisper, a faint continuous murmur (a tempting inner voice, a rustle of ornaments)
entries.charge_reading: و (وصل + ربط) + س (امتداد + سيلان) + و (وصل + ربط) + س (امتداد + سيلان) + ة: bound rounded sustain alternating with a fine streaming sibilant, reduplicated, the repeated و-س is the low continuous s-s-s of a whisper barely voiced.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'whisper', 'whoosh', French 'susurrer', Latin 'susurrus', CONVERGENT: sustained sibilants for the same hush.

entries.gloss: a whisper, the lowest audible speech, a soft footfall or hidden sound
entries.charge_reading: ه (همس + تنفس) + م (تجمّع + تلاصق) + س (امتداد + سيلان): a soft throat exhale, lips gathered, then fine streaming breath, ه is defined as 'همس' itself; the word names the breath it is made of.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'hush', 'hum', CONVERGENT: h-plus-nasal for muffled low sound.

entries.gloss: a rumbling roar, a deep continuous booming (of a camel, thunder, a torrent, a crowd)
entries.charge_reading: ه (همس + تنفس) + د (ضبط + ثبات) + ي (امتداد + سريان) + ر (تكرار + جريان): a breath-body then a grounded fixed push drawn out into a running roll, د gives the low settled weight, ر the rolling continuation of the rumble.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'roar', 'thunder', 'rumble', CONVERGENT: low vowel plus rhotic for deep continuous sound.

entries.charge_reading: ز (اندفاع + اهتزاز) + ء (تأكيد + قطع) + ي (امتداد + سريان) + ر (تكرار + جريان): a voiced vibrating thrust, a glottal catch, then a running roll, the ز-ر frame carries the vibrating chest-drawn roar, the hamza the guttural break inside it.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'roar', Greek 'bruchaomai', CONVERGENT: vibrating rhotic for the big-cat roar.

entries.gloss: the neighing / whinnying of a horse
entries.charge_reading: ص (صلابة + إطباق) + ه (همس + تنفس) + ي (امتداد + لين) + ل (تعلّق + امتداد): a hard sealed onset, a breath exhale, then a gentle extended glide, the ص-ه pair is the sharp breathy blast of the whinny, the ي-ل its drawn tail.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'neigh', 'whinny', CONVERGENT: nasal/breathy glide for the horse-call.

entries.charge_reading: ن (رنين + انبعاث) + ب (اتّصال + تمسّك) + ا (امتداد) + ح (حياة حارّة + احتواء): nasal resonance, a lip burst, an open extension, then warm throat friction, ب is the plosive bark-burst, ح the throat-rasp at its end.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'bark', 'bow-wow', 'woof', CONVERGENT: a plosive burst for the dog-call.

entries.gloss: the cawing / croaking cry of a crow or raven (also a shepherd's shout)
entries.charge_reading: ن (رنين + انبعاث) + ع (قبض حلقي + شدّة) + ي (امتداد + سريان) + ق (قطع + إحكام): nasal resonance, a deep pharyngeal grip, an extension, then a firm back cut, ع gives the harsh throat-grip of the caw, ق the sharp clipped end of the cry.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'caw', 'croak', 'cackle', CONVERGENT: velar plosives for the corvid cry.

entries.charge_reading: م (تجمّع + تلاصق) + و (وصل + ربط) + ا (امتداد) + ء (تأكيد + قطع): lips gathered and sealed, a rounded binding sustain, an open extension, then a glottal close, م-و ARE the closed-lip rounded 'mew', the exact mouth-shape of the cat-call.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'meow', 'mew', Chinese 'miao', French 'miaou', CONVERGENT: the m-w shape recurs worldwide for the cat.

entries.gloss: the chirping / twittering of small birds (sparrows, swallows)
entries.charge_reading: ز (اندفاع + اهتزاز) + ق (قطع + إحكام) + ز (اندفاع + اهتزاز) + ق (قطع + إحكام) + ة: a voiced vibrating thrust cut short by a firm back-stop, reduplicated, each ز-ق is one clipped chirp, the reduplication the rapid twitter.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'tweet', 'chirp', German 'zwitschern', CONVERGENT: high sibilant plus stop for birdsong.

entries.charge_reading: ق (قطع + إحكام) + ه (همس + تنفس) + ق (قطع + إحكام) + ه (همس + تنفس) + ة: a firm back-stop released into a throat exhale, reduplicated, the ق-ه ق-ه is literally the 'qah-qah' burst of the chest heaving out laughter.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'ha-ha', 'guffaw', 'cackle', Spanish 'jajaja', CONVERGENT: back-stop plus breath for laughter everywhere.

entries.gloss: a booming, resounding hum or roar (of distant thunder, a crowd, bees, a whirring)
entries.charge_reading: د (ضبط + ثبات) + و (وصل + ربط) + ي (امتداد + سريان): a grounded fixed push then a rounded binding sustain drawn along an extension, د is the low struck body, و-ي the long resounding tail of the boom.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'boom', 'drone', 'din', CONVERGENT: a voiced stop plus resonant for the reverberating hum.

entries.gloss: a rattling, crackling, rustling sound (of weapons, dry leaves, straw, coins)
entries.charge_reading: خ (تخلخل + اختراق) + ش (انتشار + تفرّق) + خ (تخلخل + اختراق) + ش (انتشار + تفرّق) + ة: a rarefied throat-scratch spreading and scattering, reduplicated, ش scatters the dry hiss outward, the doubled خ-ش is the repeated rattle.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'rustle', 'crackle', 'swish', CONVERGENT: hushing fricatives for the dry rattle.

entries.gloss: a clattering, clashing, rattling (of arms and armour, dry bones, thunder)
entries.charge_reading: ق (قطع + إحكام) + ع (قبض حلقي + شدّة) + ق (قطع + إحكام) + ع (قبض حلقي + شدّة) + ة: a firm back-cut gripping deep in the throat, reduplicated, each ق-ع is one hard clash, the reduplication the ongoing clatter of hard bodies striking.
entries.convergent_echo: English 'clack', 'clatter', 'clank', CONVERGENT: velar stops for hard bodies striking.
